title: wolfssl-wolfcrypt Rust trait correctness test suite
description: Implement the test suite described in PLAN.md: KAT tests against Wycheproof, NIST ACVP, and inline NIST SP 800-38A/B vectors, covering the Rust trait adapter layer for PRs #10248 (digest+signature) and #10305 (mac+kem+password-hash). Two shallow clones (wolfSSL/wychcheck, google/wycheproof) provide all external vector files.
